settings.locked_after_the_one_time_setup: Locked after the one-time setup; use ‘Reset role’ below to change it.
settings.no_role_has_been_set_yet: No role has been set yet.
settings.credentials_for_creating_member_accounts: Credentials for creating member accounts, DBs, and permissions (stored on this device only) — changes apply automatically when you leave the field.
settings.checks_access_and_permissions_for_every: Checks access and permissions for every member's mirror DB.
settings.add_your_first_member_with_add: Add your first member with ‘+ Add member’ below.
settings.one_per_line_name_id_or: One per line: ‘Name,ID,Folder’ (ID and Folder optional) or ‘Name ID’ or just ‘Name’ (ID auto-generated). Lines starting with ‘#’ are comments.
settings.base_folder_desc: When set, each member’s folder becomes ‘<base>/<name>’ (a per-line folder overrides it).
settings.secret_storage_unavailable_plaintext: Secret Storage is unavailable on this device — the password is stored in plain text in data.json. Update Obsidian (1.11.4+) if possible.
settings.roster_placeholder:
Jane Doe,jane
John Smith,john,Team/A
Alex Kim
settings.pick_members_and_deploy_to_create: Pick members and ‘Deploy’ to create the shared DB and permissions and propagate them to member members.
settings.personal_sync_desc: Back up / sync your own vault (notes & attachments) to a personal DB, excluding individual & shared space folders and .obsidian/.trash. Useful across your own devices.
settings.db_updates_transport_desc: Watch all member/shared DBs over one connection (_db_updates) instead of one connection per DB. Requires server admin credentials; falls back automatically if unsupported. Recommended with 10+ members.
settings.personal_sync_enable_desc: On: provisions a personal DB and syncs everything except managed folders. (Plugins/.obsidian are not synced.)
settings.content_templates_desc: Starting templates for new notices, lessons, and assignments. Blank uses the built-in default.
settings.create_default_template_desc: Write the built-in default template to this path and open it.
settings.edit_shared_folder_documents_character_b: Edit shared-folder documents character by character in real time via a separate Hocuspocus realtime server; propagated to members on ‘Deploy’.
settings.enable_realtime_editing_desc: When on, realtime co-editing applies to every member's personal folder and all shared spaces.
settings.realtime_token_member_hint: Tokens are delivered automatically via your private mirror when the manager deploys a shared space. Run a check if realtime isn't connecting.
settings.when_set_issues_a_signed_token: When set, issues a signed token per shared space (a leak grants access to that space only). Keep it identical to the server's YJS_SECRET and never share it. The value is kept in Secret Storage.
settings.0_no_expiry_set_a_value: 0 = no expiry. Set a value to invalidate tokens via periodic redeploy.
settings.invite_expiry_days_desc: 0 = no expiry. Expired invite codes (QR / deeplink) are refused on apply.
settings.rt_service_account_desc: Dedicated CouchDB account for the Hocuspocus server (recommended: covault-rt). Deployment creates it and grants access to all shared/personal DBs. Keep it identical to the server's COUCHDB_USER.
settings.rt_service_password_desc: Password for the dedicated account (kept in Secret Storage). Keep it identical to the server's COUCHDB_PASSWORD. Leave empty to reuse an account you created yourself.
settings.name: Name
settings.status_not_provisioned_pressing_invite_c: Status: Not provisioned — pressing ‘Invite’ creates the account and DB.
settings.scan_the_qr_from_your_manager: Scan the QR from your manager with the camera or paste the invite code below to set up automatically.
settings.paste_the_invite_code_from_your: Paste the invite code from your manager
settings.when_off_only_manual_sync_runs: When off, only manual sync runs; the change applies immediately.
settings.also_syncs_non_markdown_files_such: Also syncs non-markdown files such as images and PDFs.
settings.attachments_larger_than_this_are_not: Attachments larger than this are not synced (0 = unlimited).
settings.pauses_remote_sync_when_the_app: Pauses remote sync when the app is hidden and resumes on return to save battery and network.
settings.delay_from_edit_to_upload_on: Delay from edit to upload on mobile; longer saves more battery (no effect on desktop).
settings.decides_how_the_old_file_in: Decides how the old file in the other vault is handled on delete or rename.
settings.plaintext_secret_title: Secrets are stored in plaintext on this device
settings.plaintext_secret_desc: This Obsidian version doesn't expose Secret Storage, so passwords and tokens are saved as plaintext in data.json (inside the synced vault). Update Obsidian, keep this vault private, and rotate credentials if exposed.
settings.dashboard_page_size_desc: How many notices/assignments to show before "Show more". Default 10.
settings.deleted_files_collect_here_under_the: Deleted files collect here under the ‘Move to archive folder’ policy; removing them here permanently deletes them from the DB too.
settings.folder_where_the_remote_version_is: Folder where the remote version is extracted on conflict; resolve via the ‘Open conflict list’ command.
settings.enter_folders_to_exclude_from_sync: Enter folders to exclude from sync, separated by commas.
settings.invalid_folder_path_no_absolute_paths: Invalid folder path: {path} (no ‘..’, absolute paths, or .obsidian)
settings.archive_and_conflict_folders_overlap_use: Archive and conflict folders overlap. Use different paths.
settings.back_up_members_shared_spaces_and: Back up members, shared spaces, and options as JSON or move them to another device (excludes passwords and tokens).
settings.deletes_all_member_and_shared_databases: Deletes all member and shared databases on the server to reset the backend (irreversible · Yjs handled manually).
settings.homeroom_space_desc: Notices, lesson guides, and shared assignments are stored under this space's folder. Only one space can be the home space.
settings.also_delete_member_server_desc: Delete this member's mirror DB and CouchDB account on the server (irreversible).
settings.also_delete_shared_server_desc: Delete this shared space's database on the server (irreversible).
settings.for_switching_between_manager_and_member: For switching between manager and member roles or restarting — clears local checkpoints and cache and lets you pick the role again (server data and vault files are kept).
settings.ui_language_auto_follows_the_obsidian: UI language. ‘Auto’ follows the Obsidian language.

backup.copy_the_content_below_to_keep: Copy the content below to keep or paste on another device. For security, passwords, Yjs tokens, and member passwords are excluded.
backup.paste_the_exported_json_members_shared: Paste the exported JSON. Members, shared spaces, and options will be restored. Passwords/tokens must be re-entered on this device, and imported members need to be re-invited.

panel.invite_permission_error_403_check_this: Invite permission error (403): check this account's DB access.
panel.already_set_up_members_must_re: Already-set-up members must re-apply ‘Set up with invite code’ using this new code (reissuing invalidates the old code).
panel.see_detailed_sync_status_in_the: See detailed sync status in the ‘Sync status’ tab of the CoVault panel.
panel.checks_that_you_re_properly_connected: Checks that you're properly connected to your manager.
panel.for_troubleshooting_usually_no_need_to: For troubleshooting — usually no need to touch.
panel.open_a_note_to_see_its: Open a note to see its feedback.
panel.this_note_is_not_a_sync: This note is not a sync target.
panel.no_feedback_yet_select_text_in: No feedback yet. Select text in the body and click ‘＋ Add feedback’.
panel.could_not_focus_drawing_element: Could not focus the drawing element (open the drawing in Excalidraw).
panel.add_a_shared_space_in_settings: Add a shared space in settings.

panel.deletes_the_member_shared_dbs_on: Deletes the member/shared DBs on the server (destructive — requires typing a confirm word).
panel.re_fetches_the_shared_spaces_deployed: Re-fetches the shared spaces deployed by the manager from the server.
panel.no_members_to_sync_yet_add: No members to sync yet. Add members in settings and ‘Invite’ them.
panel.not_connected_yet_apply_the_qr: Not connected yet. Apply the QR / invite code from your manager.

Removes this shared space from the list.

panel.removes_this_member_from_the_list:
Removes this member from the list.
Server data (account & mirror DB) is kept — only the sync link is removed.
To also delete server data, use ‘Reset server data’ in the Manage tab.

panel.invalid_mirror_db_name: Invalid Mirror DB name: {value} (use lowercase letters/digits/_/-)

invite.qr_prerequisites: The member’s device needs Obsidian with the CoVault plugin installed and enabled. If scanning the QR does nothing, copy the invite code below and send it instead.
invite.copy_each_code_or_open_qr: Copy each member's code and send it, or open the QR. Codes contain the member's password — share over a secure channel.
invite.when_the_member_scans_the_qr: When the member scans the QR below with their phone's default camera, Obsidian opens and configures automatically. Or copy the code and send it so the member can paste it into 'Set up with invite code'.
invite.send_to_member_paste_into_member: Send to member → paste into Member Mode 'Set up with invite code'
invite.this_invite_contains_the_member_s: ⚠ This invite contains the member's private password (no expiry; single-use — it rotates upon apply). Share it securely with that member only; if you suspect a leak, invalidate it via ‘Reissue password’ in settings.
invite.this_invite_contains_password_expires: ⚠ This invite contains the member's private password (valid until {date}; single-use — it rotates upon apply). Share it securely with that member only; if you suspect a leak, invalidate it immediately via ‘Reissue password’ in settings.
invite.replaces_the_password_with_a_new: Replaces the password with a new one, invalidating the previous invite.
invite.password_reissue_failed_keeping_the_prev: Password reissue failed — keeping the previous password.
invite.copy_failed_select_and_copy_the: Copy failed — select and copy the code directly from the box.

conflict.both_sides_edited_the_same_file: Both sides edited the same file differently. Local is your current vault content; remote is the copy in the _conflicts/ folder.

reset.this_permanently_deletes_all_member_and: This permanently deletes all member and shared CouchDB databases on the server ({count} total). This cannot be undone.
reset.local_cache_and_provisioning_state_will: Local cache and provisioning state will be reset. Deleting only the DBs keeps the workspace roster (recoverable by re-inviting); deleting accounts too also clears the roster (members and shared spaces).
reset.also_delete_member_accounts_users_and: Also delete member accounts (_users) and workspace roster
reset.off_delete_dbs_only_accounts_and: Off: delete DBs only (accounts and roster kept). On: fully delete member accounts and the workspace roster (members and shared spaces) → you must set everything up from scratch.
reset.reset_yjs_realtime_data_manually_restart: Reset Yjs realtime data manually: restart the yjs-websocket container on the NAS or empty the ./data folder (docker compose down → delete data → up).

role.choose_the_role_to_use_in: Choose the role to use in this vault. It cannot be changed after selection; to change it, you must reset data in settings.
role.syncs_the_manager_s_member_folder: Syncs the manager's member folder with my vault. Usually set up via a manager invite (QR/code).
role.syncs_this_vault_s_member_folders: Syncs this vault's member folders with each member's vault, and invites members to manage the workspace.
role.member_set_up_directly_with_an: Member: set up directly with an invite code
role.scanning_the_qr_from_your_manager: Scanning the QR from your manager with your phone camera sets it up automatically. Or paste the invite code below.

command.validate_source_too_large: Write-permission rules for {db} are unusually large ({kb} KB) — consider reducing per-file participant assignments.

command.covault_could_not_parse_the: CoVault: Could not parse the invite code. Make sure you copied the whole code; if it keeps failing, ask the manager for a new invite.
command.no_mirror_db_to_test_manager: No mirror DB to test. (Manager: add members)

command.invite_apply_canceled: Invite was not applied (canceled by user).

command.server_data_reset_complete_invite_member: Server data reset complete. 'Invite' members → 'Redeploy' shared spaces to automatically re-sync.
command.covault_available_in_manager_mode: CoVault: Available in Manager Mode only.

sync.the_other_side_resolved_the_conflict: The other side resolved the conflict — your edit will be overwritten. Your version was kept at '{path}'.
sync.remote_change_received_while_editing_kee: Remote change received while editing: {path} — keeping your edit; remote copy saved to _conflict/. Check it in 'Conflicts'.
sync.attachment_too_large_to_download: Skipped downloading attachment over the size limit ({mb} MB): {path} ({size} MB). Raise 'Max attachment size' to receive it.
sync.realtime_session_closed_by_deletion: Closing the realtime session and applying the manager's deletion: {path}
sync.deletion_held_session_active: Deletion held — a realtime session is active (content restored at session end): {path}
sync.case_collision_skipped: Skipped applying {path} — a file that differs only by letter case already exists ({existing}). Rename one of them on the device that created it.
sync.deletion_held_pending_edit: Deletion held — this file has an edit waiting to upload (delete/modify conflict). Resolve it in Recovery: {path}
sync.autosync_off_automatic_sync_disabled_man: autoSync off — automatic sync disabled. Manual sync only.
sync.no_couchdb_url_enter_it_in: No CouchDB URL. Enter it in settings and it will be applied automatically.
sync.sync_stopped_due_to_auth_failure: Sync stopped due to auth failure: {db} — {err}. It will retry automatically once credentials/invite are fixed.
sync.readonly_write_denied: Shared files are read-only — the server rejected your change to {path}. Your edit is kept on this device; ask the manager to add you to a live session to edit it.
sync.readonly_write_denied_short: Read-only: change to {path} was rejected by the server
sync.readonly_change_reverted: Shared file is read-only — restored {path} to its state before the change. Ask the workspace admin to join a live session to edit.
sync.delete_reconcile_tombstoned_of_files_mis: Delete reconcile: tombstoned {tombstoned} of {found} files missing locally.
sync.upload_only_reconciling_deletions_withou: ‘Upload only’: reconciling deletions without comparing against the latest remote changes.
sync.delete_reconcile_skipped_no_baseline_man: Delete reconcile skipped: no baseline manifest (first sync / after cache reset).
sync.delete_reconcile_skipped_folder_changed_: Delete reconcile skipped: folder changed ‘{old}’→‘{now}’, baseline is invalid.
sync.delete_reconcile_aborted_missing_files_e: Delete reconcile aborted: {found} missing files exceed the limit (folder-misconfig guard). If this is intended, raise ‘Max delete reconcile’ in settings.
sync.max_files_to_auto_propagate_as: Max files to auto-propagate as deletions in one full sync. Above this it holds and warns (folder-misconfig guard). 0 = automatic (small default).
sync.attachment_conflict_held_preserve_local_: Attachment conflict held (preserve-local): {path} — keeping local; remote copy saved to _conflict/.
sync.failed_to_save_attachment_conflict_copy: Failed to save attachment conflict copy: {path} — {err}
sync.download_reconcile_applied_of_docs_attac: Download reconcile: applied {applied} of {notes} docs + {assets} attachments.
sync.upload_retry_conflict: Upload deferred — the document kept changing during write ({path}). It will retry on the next change or full sync.
sync.conflict_resolve_retry_failed: Could not finalize the conflict resolution for {path} — new remote changes kept arriving. The conflict stays listed; try again.
sync.tombstone_retention_stripped: Trimmed {n} deleted-file record(s) past the {days}-day retention window (sync integrity unaffected; restore expires with version history).
sync.upload_skipped_unchanged_by_stat: Incremental scan: {n} file(s) unchanged since the last baseline (skipped without reading).

diagnostics.settings_role_workspace_url_autosync_att: Settings — role={role}, workspace={classId}, URL={url}, autoSync={autoSync}, attachments={syncAssets}(max {maxMB}MB), pauseWhenHidden={pauseWhenHidden}, realtime={realtimeEnabled}
diagnostics.no_couchdb_url_please_enter_it: No CouchDB URL. Please enter it in settings first.
diagnostics.no_db_to_diagnose_manager_add: No DB to diagnose. (Manager: add a member/shared space)
diagnostics.access_denied_403_for_another_member: • {label} ({db}) — access denied (403). For another member's DB this means permission isolation is working.
diagnostics.couchdb_url_is_empty_please_enter: CouchDB URL is empty. Please enter it in settings first.
diagnostics.connection_failed_server_unreachable: Connection failed: server unreachable — {err}. Check that the URL starts with https:// and, on mobile, that the certificate is a valid HTTPS one.
diagnostics.connection_failed_auth_error_http_401: Connection failed: auth error (HTTP 401). Check your username/password.
diagnostics.no_permission_http_403_this_account: No permission (HTTP 403): this account cannot access '{db}'. (For another member's DB this means permission isolation is working)

couch.admin_provisioning_forbidden: Insufficient admin permissions: cannot access _users (HTTP {status}). A server-admin account is required to provision members.
couch.failed_to_update_account_password_repeat: Failed to update account password (repeated rev conflict)
couch.failed_to_write_document_repeated_rev: Failed to write document (repeated rev conflict)

mode.no_members_or_shared_spaces_add: No members or shared spaces. Add them in settings.
mode.db_updates_active: Unified change detection on — watching {n} DB(s) over a single connection.
mode.db_updates_unsupported: _db_updates is unavailable ({status}) — falling back to per-DB connections.
mode.db_updates_fallback: Unified change detection stopped ({reason}: {detail}) — switched back to per-DB connections.
mode.failed_to_resolve_attachment_conflict_ne: Failed to resolve attachment conflict: neither side has binary data — {path}
mode.attachment_keep_local_apply_remote_keep: Attachment · {mime} · {size} (keep local / apply remote / keep both)

recovery.restore_deleted_files_to_their_original: Restore deleted files to their original location, or permanently delete them. If a same-named file exists, it is restored as ‘(recovered)’.
recovery.cannot_recover_attachment_binary_is_gone: Cannot recover — attachment binary is gone (restore from a device that has the ‘_삭제됨/’ copy).
recovery.skipped_a_same_file_already_exists: Skipped — a same file already exists: {path}
recovery.permanently_removes_this_document_from_t: Permanently removes this document from the server DB. This cannot be undone.
recovery.no_copy_to_preview_restore_to: No copy to preview. Restore to original location first, then check.
recovery.delete_modify_conflict_s_handle_them: {n} delete/modify conflict(s) — handle them in the ‘Recover deleted’ tab (apply my delete / keep remote edit).
recovery.you_deleted_this_but_another_device: You deleted this, but another device modified it. How do you want to handle it?
recovery.keep_edit_as_copy_then_delete: Keep edit as copy, then delete
recovery.nothing_to_undo_attachment_binary_not: Nothing to undo (attachment binary not preserved).

version.snapshots_markdown_content_on_edit_delet: Snapshots markdown content on edit/delete/conflict-resolution so you can restore via the ‘Open version history’ command (stored and replicated on the server).
version.max_versions_kept_per_file_default: Max versions kept per file (default 10). Kept if within either ‘last N versions’ or ‘last N days’.
version.versions_within_this_period_are_kept: Versions within this period are kept even beyond the count limit (default 30 days).
version.no_saved_versions_recorded_on_edit: No saved versions. (Recorded on edit / delete / conflict resolution.)
version.open_a_note_to_see_its: Open a note to see its version history.

group.name: Group name
group.none: No groups yet. Bundle members into a group.
group.none_member: You're not in any group yet.
group.delete_confirm: Delete group '{name}'? Its chat will be removed too.
group.manage_hint: Groups are used for chat and live-session participants.
group.request_folder_hint: Once approved, this folder becomes the group's shared space — realtime co-editing works only inside it.
group.request_member_hint: Request a group of members — once the manager approves, you get a group chat and a group folder with realtime co-editing.
group.request_needs_homeroom: Group requests need a home shared space.
group.request_sent: Sent the request for group '{name}'. Available after manager approval.
group.roster_missing: The manager hasn't published the roster yet, so requests aren't available.
group.requests_waiting: {n} group request(s) are waiting for approval. Handle them in the Groups tab.
group.request_deploy_failed: Failed to deploy the space for group '{name}'. The request stays pending.
group.delete_space_confirm: Delete group '{name}'? Its chat and group-space sync will be removed (files in each vault remain).
group.auto_approve_desc: Automatically approve member group requests and deploy the group space. When off, approve manually in the Groups tab.
group.max_per_member_desc: How many group requests a member can have pending at once.
